name: TopGum Industries Ltd.
summary: TopGum Industries Ltd. develops, manufactures, imports, sells, and markets dietary and nutritional supplement gummies. The company offers women’s health, beauty from within, active lifestyle, gut health, and immune support gummies. It also imports and markets other sweets, including chocolate, marshmallows, crackers, chewing gum, and candies products. TopGum Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Sderot, Israel.
